clauses.claim: Given a livenessProbe/readinessProbe/startupProbe value (root for the gremlin DaemonSet, chao.* for the chao Deployment), the corresponding container renders that exact Probe object under the matching field.

Given user-supplied initContainers (root for gremlin, chao.initContainers for chao), each entry is appended to the rendered initContainers list, after the chart-managed seccomp-init entry when it is present.

rejects.claim: An initContainers entry whose name collides with a chart-reserved container name (seccomp-init, gremlin, chao) fails the template render with a message naming the collision, on both workloads, including when GPU fan-out is enabled.

clauses.claim: Given extraVolumes/extraVolumeMounts values (root for gremlin, chao.* for chao), each entry is appended to the pod's volumes and the target container's volumeMounts, including bringing chao's volumeMounts key into existence when no pre-existing condition already renders it.

rejects.claim: An extraVolumes or extraVolumeMounts entry whose name collides with a chart-reserved volume name fails the template render with a message naming the collision, on both workloads.

clauses.claim: Given a lifecycle value (root for gremlin, chao.lifecycle for chao), the corresponding container renders that exact Lifecycle object.
Given an envFrom value (root for gremlin, chao.envFrom for chao), each listed source is appended to the corresponding container's envFrom.
Given a terminationGracePeriodSeconds value (root for gremlin, chao.terminationGracePeriodSeconds for chao), including the value 0, the rendered pod spec carries that exact value.
Given a dnsConfig value (root for gremlin, chao.dnsConfig for chao), the rendered pod spec carries that exact PodDNSConfig object.
Given a hostAliases value (root for gremlin, chao.hostAliases for chao), the rendered pod spec carries that exact HostAlias list.

Given a podSecurityContext value (root for gremlin, chao.podSecurityContext for chao), the rendered pod spec carries that exact SecurityContext at the pod level, alongside the existing container-level securityContext unaffected.
With every EN-11853 value left unset, `helm template` output for the gremlin DaemonSet and chao Deployment (secretauth values fixture) is byte-identical to the pre-EN-11853 rendering.

probe.run: diff <(helm template my-release gremlin -f gremlin/tests/values-secretauth-test.yaml -s templates/daemonset.yaml) gremlin/tests/fixtures/en11853_backward_compat.gremlin.yaml && diff <(helm template my-release gremlin -f gremlin/tests/values-secretauth-test.yaml -s templates/chao-deployment.yaml) gremlin/tests/fixtures/en11853_backward_compat.chao.yaml

perturbation.apply: sed -i 's/^        version: v1$/        version: v1\n        en11853-canary-label: "true"/' gremlin/templates/_daemonset.tpl

clauses.claim: Setting gremlin.extraEnv/chao.extraEnv to a value colliding with a chart-managed name does not fail the template render — extraEnv remains exempt from the reserved-name collision check added by this contract.

perturbation.apply: sed -i '14a{{- fail "en11853 perturbation: extraEnv reserved-name check reintroduced" -}}' gremlin/templates/_daemonset.tpl
